behavioral_effects: governance context and impact queries for .claude/** now surface the rule that user-level skills are not duplicated under .claude/skills/ and that task-observer-staged updates to repository skills land only through gov-change gated by skills-check.
compatibility_impact: None. governance/manifests/generated/components.json and governance/manifests/effective/repository.json each gain one invariant string for agent-operating-surface; no contract, schema, route, event, or validator registry entry changes.
follow_up: The skill review is not scheduled: cloud routines cannot reach ~/.claude, so the observer relies on its in-session 7-day fallback offer or an explicit request.
limitations: The originally planned CLAUDE.md bullet was dropped: the simplify pass (four reviewers: reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude) found it restated the global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, which is loaded in every session here, and placed the one non-derivable fact at the wrong altitude. The invariant is the only repository-side text. Nothing could be deleted or consolidated: no existing text covered user-level skills.
Net-positive diff of one annotation line, because the rule is new to the repository.
reason: The task-observer skill is installed once at user level and activated from the global CLAUDE.md, but its default workspace rule and staging rules say nothing about this repository: an agent could re-anchor the observation log under the working directory or duplicate the observer into .claude/skills/, where skills-check would reject its non-repository path citations. The note pins the global workspace and states that staged updates to the repo's skills land only through gov-change plus skills-check
risks: The invariant is prose, enforced by review, not by a check. skills-check is the de facto backstop: a repository copy of task-observer cites non-repository paths and would fail it.
rollback: Revert the commit; the two manifests are in the same commit, so governance-sync is a no-op afterwards. A revert does not touch the user-level pieces outside the repository: ~/.claude/skills/task-observer/, the workspace ~/.claude/skill-observations/ and ~/.claude/skill-updates/, and the Task Observer section appended to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md - remove those by hand if the observer is retired.
security_impact: None. One invariant string added to a curated component annotation (.claude/.governance.json) and compiled into two manifests by governance-sync. No code, configuration, dependency, hook, permission, or exposure surface changes. The task-observer skill itself is installed at user level (~/.claude/skills/), outside the repository, and stages updates rather than writing to live skill directories.
summary: Document the globally installed task-observer skill and its install rules for this repository
